svg.title: Sands of Time — Dominion of Hours. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance (roster pass) / Sand classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Borrowed Hours forks into Quickened Sands then Sovereign of the Hour, or Brittle with Age then The Inevitable Hour. Suspended Moment forks into Held in Stasis then Timeless Bastion, or Leaden Seconds then Stilled Hourglass. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Sand jutsu.

Timeshift adds a second, broad 35% exposure row and Cellular Regeneration a static Heal 25 (250 HP per tick). The tree follows those pairs: an offensive Foundation on Momentum Shift (strike harder myself or age the target) and a defensive Foundation on Timelapse (shelter myself or weaken them). Routes: Burst +8% Increase Damage Given into a controlled +2 Damage payoff (Timeshift and Timelapse 40 \u2192 42, Eternity Flux 50 \u2192 52), Exposure +8% Increase Damage Taken, Fortress +10% Decrease Damage Taken with +5% Heal, Suppression +10% Decrease Damage Given. Stun, timecompression and barrier are unsupported and receive nothing."},"nodes":[{"id":"01","name":"Borrowed Hours","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagetaken","flat":2,"display_role":"ENEMY DEBUFF"},{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":2,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"}],"flavor":"Every second stolen from them is a second lent to you.","coverage_note":"Increase Damage Taken 35 \u2192 37% on Timeshift (four stat types, no element) and Momentum Shift (Earth/None/Sand/Wind hits); Changes from Draft 4: the +5 Damage route becomes a controlled burst (Grinding Sands / Erosion of Eternity become Quickened Sands +3% Increase Damage Given / Sovereign of the Hour +3% Increase Damage Given and +2 Damage); The Inevitable Hour drops its Increase Damage Given rider and is pure exposure (2/2/4 = +8%); Suspended Moment trades Heal +2% for Decrease Damage Given +2%; Timeless Bastion carries the whole +5% Heal; Stilled Hourglass is +5% Decrease Damage Given (route still +10%) with +2% Decrease Damage Taken. Roster pass: Sovereign of the Hour was a bare +5% Increase Damage Given (route +10% on one row, out-valued by Exposure in most windows); it is now Arashima's Sundered Sky shape, +3% and +2 Damage (RUL-2026-10-04-003).","Flat Damage is +2 and sits on the Advanced Art only: Timeshift and Timelapse 40 \u2192 42 (still Normal), Eternity Flux 50 \u2192 52, past the Nuke tier (above_nuke_rationale). The old +5 took the 40s to 45 and Eternity Flux to 55. Damage reaches the caster's Sand strikes only; the kit's percentage rows and the Earth/None/Sand/Wind Increase Damage Given passive multiply it.","Burst vs Exposure at 3 BP, with the offensive fourth (Brittle with Age / Quickened Sands) in brackets; base kit \u00d72.46 with all three Momentum Shift / Timeshift rows live. In that combo window the caster's Eternity Flux takes \u00d72.79 [\u00d72.87] under Burst and \u00d72.80 [\u00d72.86] under Exposure, a Timelapse hit \u00d72.82 [\u00d72.90] vs \u00d72.80 [\u00d72.86], but an element-less hit (no flat Damage) only \u00d72.68 [\u00d72.76]. Sand strikes in the Timeshift window alone: \u00d71.42\u20131.44 [\u00d71.45\u20131.46] vs \u00d71.43; in the Momentum Shift window alone: \u00d72.04\u20132.06 [\u00d72.07\u20132.09] vs \u00d71.96 [\u00d72.00]. Outside the windows Burst keeps +4\u20135% on every Sand strike and Exposure gives nothing; an ally's hit on the marked target takes \u00d71.88 [\u00d71.93] vs \u00d72.04. Exposure is the team route and wins the caster's non-Sand hits whenever Timeshift's row is live; Burst owns the caster's own Sand strikes, on unmarked targets too (Timelapse's circle in the Momentum Shift window \u00d71.50 vs \u00d71.37). Exposure stays at the batch's two-row +8% (director question).","Defence: both routes use one Timelapse cast. An enemy in the circle hits the caster at \u00d70.408 (Fortress) or \u00d70.396 (Suppression) at 3 BP, \u00d70.39 or \u00d70.378 with the sibling Hidden Art (base \u00d70.49); the Fortress keeps its Heal, the Suppression covers every enemy in the circle and the caster's allies. Maxima over every legal allocation: Increase Damage Given +8%, Increase Damage Taken +8%, Decrease Damage Taken +10%, Decrease Damage Given +10%, Heal +5%, Damage +2.","Matching and delivery (tags.ts 3477\u20133510; \u00a73b): Timeshift's exposure and Timelapse's rows list four stat types and no element, so they match nearly every non-pierce hit; Momentum Shift's exposure matches only Earth/None/Sand/Wind hits; its self buff ('Highest', no element) matches the caster's highest-stat and element-less hits. Every cast has cooldown 7 and buff/debuff rows act the two rounds after the cast round only."],"risks":["Classification: Sand is the single signature element and no other captured kit carries it. 4 of 9 kit rows carry Sand; the other five need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver, and Cellular Regeneration carries no element on any row, so in-kit it qualifies only through an authored Sand jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit Sand coverage is unverified.","Ally hazard: Timelapse's Sand damage hits every other user inside the circle, allies included (friendly fire none = ALL; the caster never; actions.ts 1029-1060), so Sovereign of the Hour raises it 40 \u2192 42 EP for them too. Only enemies get its Decrease Damage Given row, and the Decrease Damage Taken row is self-targeted.","Exposure reach: The Inevitable Hour's 43% rows amplify allies' hits as well as the caster's, and any other Increase Damage Taken source multiplies again (stacking on, process.ts 1109-1117). Team value is larger than the duel arithmetic above.","Area suppression reach: Stilled Hourglass's 40% Decrease Damage Given lands on every enemy in the Timelapse circle and cuts their damage to the caster's allies too; worth more in team battles than one row suggests.","Heal: static heal is \u00d710 HP per tick, so +5% Heal adds 50 HP per tick (600 per cast vs 500). The SELF row on the EMPTY_GROUND spiral lands on the caster at cast time, not through the tiles (actions.ts 980-1004), and ticks on the two following rounds only. Healprevent blocks it.","Highest-stat resolution (G16): Momentum Shift's self buff lists 'Highest', resolved from the caster's highestOffence (a required BattleUserState field, types.ts 156). If undefined, it would still match element-less hits and the kit's own Sand rows, not other elemental jutsu.","No combat simulation: stun, timecompression, the barrier, circle target counts, AP and uptime were not modelled. the hour: shelter myself or slow the hands raised against us?"},"route_identities":{"03":"burst: self-amplification setup, controlled +2 Damage payoff on the caster's Sand strikes, any target","05":"exposure: one marked target takes more from everyone","08":"fortress: endure and recover","10":"suppression: blunt every enemy in the circle"},"director_review":"Two questions. (1) Sovereign of the Hour's +2 Damage lifts Eternity Flux 50 \u2192 52, past the Nuke tier, as the controlled payoff of Quickened Sands' self-amplification setup (Blood-Enchanted Eyes / Shakunetsu Sakura precedent, RUL-2026-10-04-001/002): confirm it, or keep Damage unamplified. (2) The Inevitable Hour is a primary team-wide exposure route at +8% Increase Damage Taken on two compounding rows, above the +5% the director accepted for exposure on Blood-Enchanted Eyes and Shakunetsu Sakura: confirm or trim, together with the roster's other two-row exposure routes.","concerns":["Eternity Flux 50 \u2192 52 under Sovereign of the Hour (above_nuke_rationale). If the director declines it, Damage stays unamplified and Sovereign needs another identity-compatible rider beside its +3% Increase Damage Given; a bare +10% single-row route would have no anchor (Shakunetsu Sakura's +10% single-row Increase Damage Given routes carry +5% Heal or +3% Decrease Damage Given, and Arashima's single row stops at +8% with a +2 Damage or Lifesteal rider).","Increase Damage Taken +8% on two compounding, team-wide rows is above the +5% the director accepted for exposure on Blood-Enchanted Eyes (three rows) and Shakunetsu Sakura (two rows, with a +2 Damage payoff). It is the kit's primary Control identity; it should move with the roster's other two-row exposure routes (Aerathiel, Crystal Essence, Kyuko-sei, Godstorm Eclipse, Houkyuken), not alone.","Exposure out-values Burst on allies' hits and on the caster's non-Sand hits whenever Timeshift's row is live (combo window \u00d72.80 vs \u00d72.68 element-less; an ally's hit \u00d72.04 vs \u00d71.88); Burst leads on the caster's Sand strikes outside the Timeshift window and on unmarked targets, and is within 1% of Exposure on Sand strikes inside it. Party size and window uptime were not simulated.","Every percentage row except Momentum Shift's exposure needs the proposed jutsu-classification resolver; Burst's +2 Damage reaches three natively Sand rows and does not."]}}

g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Sand jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Sovereign of the Hour path + Brittle with Age
The Inevitable Hour path + Suspended Moment
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · HEAL: Heal
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE SANDS OF TIME KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
On a static Heal effect each +1% Heal adds 1 heal power, which heals 10 HP per tick (display conflict under review).
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance (roster pass) / Sand classification / forked tree
